verdict.rationale: Greptile is a SaaS code-review platform, so letting users subscribe to its events via outbound webhooks is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents an MCP server, a CLI, Fix-with-your-Agent handoffs and config files, but nothing about webhook subscriptions. The IP allowlisting note concerns Greptile reaching customers' GitHub or GitLab instances, not a webhook feature users can subscribe to.
